```{r}
input <- "1113122113"
```

```{r}
for (i in 1:4) {
  
  ile <- input %>% 
    str_extract_all("(\\d)\\1*") %>% 
    unlist() %>% 
    str_length()
  
  co <- input %>% 
    str_extract_all("(\\d)\\1*") %>% 
    unlist() %>% 
    str_sub(1, 1)
  input <- paste0(ile, co, collapse = "")
}
```

```{r}
str_length(input)
```

```{r}
dalej <- function(x) {
  ile <- input %>% 
    str_extract_all("(\\d)\\1*") %>% 
    unlist() %>% 
    str_length()
  
  co <- input %>% 
    str_extract_all("(\\d)\\1*") %>% 
    unlist() %>% 
    str_sub(1, 1)
  input <<- paste0(ile, co, collapse = "")
}
```
